findings.area: DIREKTE NÅ — live item channel label
findings.issue: The channel/competition label for 'Diamond League-finalen (Memorial Van Damme, Brussel)' wraps mid-word: 'NRK' breaks across two lines as 'N' then 'RK', right-aligned in the live-item meta column. The abbreviation is unrecognizable at a glance until both fragments are read together — the opposite of the calm, scannable 'where to watch' promise for the one section meant to answer that instantly (what's on right now).

findings.area: DIREKTE NÅ — live item channel label
findings.issue: Same event, same bug at this width: 'NRK' breaks as 'NR' then 'K' on two lines in the live-item meta column (right-aligned, under the 'Diamond League-finalen' live row). The break point shifts with width, confirming it's the column's word-wrapping, not a one-off. The same event's entry further down in the full day-grouped agenda ('4.–5. september … Wanda Diamond League · NRK') renders 'NRK' intact on one line — the bug is confined to the DIREKTE NÅ summary list.

notes: Captured as ~900px-tall viewport scroll slices per width (11 slices at 375px, 10 at 393px, 8 at 900px light) rather than one squashed full-page PNG, since the full-page capture (up to ~19000px tall) downscales past legibility when read as a single image.

Every match/tournament name read in full at all three widths — no truncation hiding a side of a fixture or a Norwegian name (e.g. 'Brighton & Hove Albion – Leeds United', 'Borussia Mönchengladbach – SV Elversberg', 'Rosenborg – HamKam') — no repeat of the historical 'Brazil – Nor…' truncation bug.

Every agenda row and every DIREKTE NÅ live item shows a channel, and every one seen is Norwegian/Scandinavian or a legitimate direct tournament stream: TV 2 Play, Viaplay, HBO Max (Sport), Discovery+, VG+ Sport, NRK, YouTube (Global Chess League) — no FOX/ESPN/Sky.
No horizontal scroll or overflow at any width; nothing clipped at the screen edge; chevrons and (i) info icons stay fully visible on every inspected row at 375px, 393px, and 900px.

Club crests and national flags render as real images (no broken-image icons or empty boxes) at every width; a generic calendar glyph appears for entries without a crest (e.g. handball fixtures, Elkjøp-ligaen) — a placeholder, not a broken image.
Must-see accent dots appear sparingly (a handful per day), not on every row.

Header, day-group headings ('I DAG', 'I MORGEN', weekday headers), and footer (calendar-subscribe line, freshness/AI-budsjett line, esports 'NESTE OPP' block, 'Dette dekker vi'/'Merker og kilder' disclosures) all intact and aligned at all three widths.

Single quiet column, generous spacing, scannable — not a cluttered grid — at all three widths; at 900px (light theme) the agenda column sits centered with the floating Assistent button resting in the empty right margin, overlapping nothing.

The floating 'Assistent' button overlaps mid-agenda rows at various scroll positions at 375/393px (by design, DESIGN.md § Hjelperen) but never covers the true last agenda row or the footer — confirmed by scrolling to the actual bottom of the page at all three widths.
